_about: Hand-picked photo choices, applied on top of cache/media.json (so re-running fetch_media.py doesn't undo them). Keys are species IDs. 'first': observation links of photos to show first, in this order. 'not_in_quiz': observation links of photos that are real but misleading out of context, so the quiz skips them (they still show in the species panel). Say why in 'why'.

62671.name: kudzu
62671.why: The old first photo shows small runners on a sidewalk, which look like clover. These show kudzu's big three-part leaves up close, then how it smothers a wall.
